candidate_evidence.quote: Sintilimab 200 mg will be administered by intravenous infusion once every 21 days for up to 1 year as part of enhanced adjuvant therapy after completion of concurrent chemoradiotherapy.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Intensified Adjuvant Therapy for High-Risk Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma With Subtotal Resection or Short-Term Progression

role_evidence.quote: After completion of concurrent chemoradiotherapy, participants will receive adjuvant temozolomide combined with sintilimab and bevacizumab.
Bevacizumab 10 mg/kg will be administered by intravenous infusion once every 21 days for up to 1 year as part of enhanced adjuvant therapy after completion of concurrent chemoradiotherapy.

Temozolomide will be administered concurrently with postoperative radiotherapy for approximately 28 days, followed by adjuvant temozolomide in combination with sintilimab and bevacizumab according to the study treatment protocol.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

coder_notes: Single-arm Phase 2: Stupp chemoradiotherapy with dose-escalated boost, then adjuvant temozolomide + sintilimab + bevacizumab. Bevacizumab is an established GBM therapy used here in the newly diagnosed adjuvant setting (rule 6, established_therapy_experiment), leaving sintilimab as the only investigational candidate (experimental_monotherapy). Radiotherapy dose intensification also part of the experimental question.
